name: Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling documentation
notes: HPA controller runs periodically (default 15s interval). Scales based on CPU/memory utilization or custom metrics. Uses ratio: desiredReplicas = ceil(currentReplicas * currentMetricValue / desiredMetricValue). For CPU, fetches from resource metrics API. Supports custom metrics via custom.metrics.k8s.io and external.metrics.k8s.io.
